name: Vayu & Dwarkadhish Coral Monarchies
notes: Two old coastal principalities under coral-stone arches: Vayu at North Dwarka and Dwarkadhish at Dwarka. They guard the Dwarka Gate and the sacred conch trade. Old coastal principalities under coral-stone arches that guard the interdimensional Dwarka Gate structures, and hold deep-sea diving, textiles and the sacred conch trade under a strict naval watch over the western sea gates. A nation of the Age of Machinery, on the pre-Shattering chart. Its people are not yet named in canon, so its culture is `unknown` rather than a guess.
